info.name: Crypto Data API
info.description:
Keyless crypto market data: 12 major coins, global market stats, fear & greed index and a sentiment digest.

**Base URL:** https://satgas.ai.id/api

**Auth:** none needed. The free tier accepts anonymous calls (10 requests/minute per IP) and this collection deliberately ships no API key or secret. Paid tiers add an `X-API-Key` header for 100-500 req/min.

**Freshness contract:** the snapshot rebuilds every 15 minutes and every /v1/market response carries `_meta.age_seconds`. If the snapshot is older than 30 minutes the API returns `503` instead of stale prices.

**Docs and spec:** https://satgas.ai.id/crypto/api/ · OpenAPI 3.0.3: https://satgas.ai.id/crypto/api/openapi.yaml

**CORS:** not enabled, call it server-side (backend, script, cron, agent tool).

Response examples in this collection are real captures from production, not hand-written.

request.description: Service health check. Returns the service status and how many coins the current snapshot holds. Cheap enough to use as a monitor probe.

Full snapshot in one flat JSON payload: every coin (price, 24h and 7d change, volume, market cap), global market stats, the fear & greed index, a sentiment digest, and a _meta block. Use _meta.age_seconds to decide whether the read is fresh: the snapshot rebuilds every 15 minutes and the API answers 503 instead of serving data older than 30 minutes.

response.name: 200 OK - live capture 2026-10-27 07:08 WIB

request.description: One coin by ticker. Change the collection variable `sym` (default BTC) to any of: BTC, ETH, BNB, SOL, XRP, ADA, DOGE, AVAX, LINK, DOT, TRX, LTC. Unknown symbols return 404, malformed ones (over 10 chars or non-alphanumeric) return 400, both always with an {"error": ...} body.
Current fear & greed index: numeric value plus the provider label (e.g. Neutral). Same numbers that appear inside /v1/market under fear_greed.

variable.description: Ticker used by the 'Coin by symbol' request.
